description: Full-scale (échelle 1) mock-up of the Ariane 5 launcher standing outdoors with an Earth globe at the reception/entrance of the Centre Spatial Guyanais beside the Guyaspace Expérience museum (ex-Musée de l'Espace, rebuilt 2022-24 and reopened 26 July 2024). Not flight hardware: a display model, though the museum inside holds real Ariane hardware (Vulcain engine, HM7 chamber, Viking injector) and satellite models. Photographed October 2018 (Sagaphoto), 5 September 2022 (Wikimedia Commons, camera position 5.168644 -52.683498) and described by visitors after the 2024 reopening as full-scale rockets outside.
aliases: Ariane 5; Ariane5; Ariane V; Ariane 5 mock-up
